AUTHOR: Shi
TITLE: Pomerania Fish: A dataset for fishes across Pomerania freshwater waterbodies in-situ environments
REGION: Pomerania rivers (Teufelsgraben, Gowienica, Ina, Drawa, Plociczna, Korytnica), Poland/Germany, Central Europe
SPECIES: Salmo trutta m. trutta (male/female), S. trutta m. fario (adult/juvenile), Salmoninae juvenile, Thymallus thymallus, Perca fluviatilis, Rutilus rutilus, Oncorhynchus mykiss, Leuciscus idus
DATA: Own in-situ GoPro Hero 5 videos 2015-2024 (22 episodes, 37 segments); PomerFishObj 14,989 images, PomerFishSeg 1,115 images (Zenodo)
V_EV: Methods, Dataset annotations: 'Frames with poor visibility or uncertain species identification were excluded from the annotation process.'
D2: 80/20 train/validation, class-stratified by instances (no separate test set)
D_EV: Methods: 'we split the PomerFishObj dataset into training (80%) and validation (20%) sets for each class based on their number of instances (Table 2)'
R_EV: Technical Validation: 'The model achieved a precision of 0.92, a recall of 0.90... mAP_0.5 of 0.91' (validation split of the same dataset only)
E_EV: Table 4: detection F1 0.92, recall 0.90, precision 0.91, mAP_0.5 0.91; segmentation mean IoU 0.86 (technical-validation metrics only)
METR: Precision, recall, F1, mAP@0.5, mAP@0.5:0.95, confusion matrix; mean IoU, pixel accuracy, per-class IoU
NOTE: Dataset paper with baseline experiments on own field footage. Split is per-class instance-stratified at frame level with no grouping by video -> 이미지/프레임 무작위; validation set only (no held-out test). P1 applied: poor-visibility frames excluded without measurement -> V_ALL=N (V3=Y: daylight recording with varied light). F1/precision/recall-confidence curves shown (Fig 7a) but no threshold value stated in text -> C1=NR. 'Pre-trained weights' source not stated -> PRE=NR. Text is unedited article-in-press version.
